title: Evolution of the sulfur strand length distribution in lithium organo-sulfur batteries monitored through operando X-ray absorption spectrometry
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01115A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Konstantin Skudler, Rukiya Matsidik, Ayda Gholamhosseinian, Hongfei Yang, Michael Walter, Michael Sommer, Matthias Müller
We present the quantitative evolution of the sulfur strand length distribution in organo-sulfur cathodes, determined by operando X-ray absorption spectrometry based on a self-absorption corrected linear combination analysis.
